name: incomerank-remotion
description: Remotion demo for the Income Rank README header + social cards

scripts.gif: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/incomerank-hero.mp4 -vf "fps=16,scale=900:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen=max_colors=144:stats_mode=diff" out/.palette.png && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/incomerank-hero.mp4 -i out/.palette.png -lavfi "fps=16,scale=900:-1:flags=lanczos,paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4:diff_mode=rectangle" out/incomerank-hero.gif
scripts.render: bun run audio && npm run render:hero && npm run render:social && npm run gif
